title: Read repository content
responsibility: Reads Git output, resolves commit revisions and retrieves tracked file names or text.

inputs.name: gitRead.root
inputs.description: The repository directory for the Git command.

inputs.name: gitRead.args
inputs.description: The Git arguments to execute directly. Callers must choose read-only arguments when a read is intended; this helper does not restrict commands.

inputs.name: gitRevision.root
inputs.description: The repository whose revision should be resolved.

inputs.name: gitRevision.revision
inputs.description: The revision to resolve as a commit; defaults to HEAD. Must be nonempty, at most 300 characters and contain no null character.

inputs.name: gitFiles.root
inputs.description: The repository whose tracked files should be listed.

inputs.name: gitFiles.revision
inputs.description: The revision to resolve before listing files.

inputs.name: gitText.root
inputs.description: The repository containing the requested text.

inputs.name: gitText.revision
inputs.description: The revision to resolve before reading the file.

inputs.name: gitText.path
inputs.description: The repository-relative file path. Absolute slash-prefixed paths, parent-directory segments and null characters are refused.

outputs.name: gitRead
outputs.description: A promise for standard output with Git terminal prompting disabled and a 64,000,000-byte output buffer limit. Git execution failures reject.

outputs.name: gitRevision
outputs.description: A promise for the resolved commit hash with surrounding whitespace removed.

outputs.name: gitFiles
outputs.description: A promise for recursively listed tracked paths, split on null separators so spaces and newlines in names are preserved.

outputs.name: gitText
outputs.description: A promise for the file text at the resolved commit. Text exceeding 2,000,000 bytes is refused.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws or rejects invalid revisions, unsafe paths, oversized source text or Git execution failures.
